title: Mixed Event — Tied By Painful Hope — Episode3 A Song That Can Spread Hope

meta.Episode: Episode3 — A Song That Can Spread Hope
meta.Event Outline: With their new outfits completed, MORE MORE JUMP! next gets someone to help create an original song for their next show. The composer gets to work, but then faces some troubles...

rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A karaoke place was a good idea since it'd have let us sing without causing a disturbance, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why are they closed today?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For electrical maintenance it looks like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Talk about bad timing...
Wait, is this because my luck's so terrible...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Don't worry, Minori, I'm sure this is just happenstance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So why don't we just try a different karaoke place? There should be several more around here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it's Sunday, so most places are gonna be packed. See all the people waiting to get into those ones? That's why I was betting on my usual hole-in-the-wall...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The rehearsal studios are probably all full too. Plus, it's almost time for...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Oh... H-Hello, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hasegawa's here!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Thank you all for waiting!
I-I've been looking forward to today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Allow us to thank you again for meeting us like this, Hasegawa. Unfortunately, you may've come all this way for...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: I see... That is unfortunate.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Again, we're sorry for making you go through all this trouble.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: No, I live just right there, so it's okay! Really!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I woke up really early today to warm up my voice too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you. But we don't have much of a choice, huh? Let's just figure out another time to do this and...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Well... If it's okay with all of you, would you like to come over to my place?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Your place?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Yes...!
I should have enough equipment to make it possible for me to check your vocal ranges.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Still, are you sure...
Won't the rest of your family be there too?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
They should be out today.
But my room may seem a bit cramped if that's alright...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (As idols, I feel like we should avoid going over to the house of someone we just met...)

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <That was when I decided to start making songs that have the power to give all their listeners belief in a “better tomorrow”...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, if it's okay with all of you, I'd like to accept her invitation... What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course. Thanks, Hasegawa. We really appreciate your kind offer!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: You're welcome...!
Riho's Room

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
S-Step right in...
Um, I know it's cramped, but please sit wherever you like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for having us!
Wow, you do have a lot of equipment here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This looks like a soundproof rug too. It's almost like we're in an actual studio.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: I-It's nothing special, really... They're just things I bought with what I'd been saving...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Anyway... Wh-Why don't we start checking your vocal ranges?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whew... I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Nice work, Minori.
Here, have some water.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, Haruka...
Argh... I couldn't sing low at all...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: But you were able to sing really high, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: In your case, Hinomori, your voice had this clarity that made it sound like you were whispering. And Momoi, your midrange packed such a powerful punch...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Haru... Kiritani, you have this dignifying aura about you. I was really impressed by all of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Having these different qualities means we could conceivably sing a wide variety of songs.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, we could.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: And I promise to write songs that bring out the best of all of your voices!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you!
We really appreciate it, Hasegawa!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm still really amazed by how you can come up with melodies in a snap! That's on top of matching it to how high our voices can go too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's right. Your musical knowledge seems to span so many genres. Not only do you do bright and cheerful well, but you also have so many other tools in your bag...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you.
I'm still nothing special, but I have been doing this for a little while now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see. That sort of explains why you seem so skilled. By the way, how long have you been doing this?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Oh, I started playing with this app on my parents' tablet when I was in elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: But I didn't actually start writing any songs until I started junior high.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: That was actually because of you, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, me?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: I began doing this because I thought it'd be fun to write or compose whatever came to mind, but I struggled to find any success.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: I ended up telling myself that this is probably the best I can do since I was just playing around...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: That was also around the time I started junior high. On top of having trouble making any new friends, this one bully started picking on me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: But you, Kiritani, and ASRUN helped me think, “Something good might happen tomorrow, so make sure to go to school!”

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: That was when they began playing ASRUN songs during lunch. This other person in my group from class got really excited and we immediately became friends.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Then, I started talking with more people about ASRUN and I even began sharing the songs I made with them. Including the bully...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Hehe... You and ASRUN's music really saved me that time, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: After that, I began learning more about songwriting and composing. All to spread hope to others the way ASRUN did with me...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: So I decided that I also want to write songs that can give someone hope...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hasegawa...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm speechless...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The hope I gave someone grew and is trying to spread hope to others now...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Hasegawa...!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: Huh? Wah! Y-Yes, Hanasato?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know exactly how you feel, Hasegawa!
Haruka and the others always found ways to cheer me up whenever I wasn't feeling great! That's why I also want to give back...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hasegawa...
We promise to really put our hearts into your song and sing in a way that does it justice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So let's keep spreading hope together...!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Okay!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: I... I absolutely promise to write a song that's worthy of your very first solo show! So thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Oh, about this part... Would it be alright if I changed how it sounds? As it stands, it feels a bit dark and not very MMJ, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
We'd rather it be a brighter melody.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<How do you feel about the lyrics?
Which do you think is better? The first or second?>

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line:
I like the first one!
The second one sounds wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmmmm...!
I can't decide! They're both so good!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. This is going to determine how our song sounds, so we'll want to think about this carefully.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Haha. Please take as much time as you like...!>
One week later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We should be getting the demo for our song soon.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Once we know what our song sounds like, we'll need to start working on the choreography on top of getting everything else ready for our show...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hehe. We have so much on our plate. It won't be easy, but we can just take it one step at a time.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?
